subject: Request: Short-term credit uplift for late-night throughput dry run
messages:
From: Elena Morris <elena.morris@brightcart.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@brightcart.com
Date: Mon, 27 Feb 2028 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: BrightCart request: short window throughput credits for night dry run

Hi Tessa,

Quick one — engineering wants to run a targeted overnight dry run (22:00-04:00 PST) this Thursday to validate p95 under a 3k RPS profile for our checkout vector. Our internal quota will run out mid-run unless we get an ephemeral top-up.

Can Redwood apply a short-term, one-time credit uplift (roughly 60k token-equivalent / 6,000 calls) to our trial account for that window? We only need it for the run; afterward we can revert to the regular trial limits. Procurement is looped in for the paperwork if needed.

Attached is the dry-run plan and the KPI matrix so you can see expected distribution.

Thanks — Elena

--
Elena Morris
Sr. Infrastructure Engineer | BrightCart
elena.morris@brightcart.com
attachments: brightcart-night-dryrun-plan.yaml (text), kpi_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Subject: Re: BrightCart request: short window throughput credits for night dry run

Elena —

Thanks for the plan and KPIs. We can support a short, time-boxed uplift from our promo pool but I need to confirm a few things before we push credits live:

- Confirm exact start/end in UTC (you listed 22:00-04:00 PST — I have that as 06:00-12:00 UTC next day).
- Desired absolute token allowance (you mentioned ~60k token-equivalent; please confirm).
- Are you okay with a single-use ephemeral voucher that expires 6 hours after the window ends?

Jordan & Dev — can you weigh in on the risk/impact to evening capacity and whether we need to reserve dedicated slots for the run? Also flag if we should attach the Redlined credit T&Cs to BrightCart before enabling.

If everything looks good I can request a promo allocation and have our finance/ops stamp it.

Best,

Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

Jordan / Dev / Grace —

Summary: BrightCart (BRG-2028-1124) needs a one-time uplift for a Thursday 22:00-04:00 PST dry run to validate p95 at ~3k RPS. They estimate ~60k token-equivalent (6k API calls).

Ask: Approve temporary promo allocation of 75k tokens (buffered), expiring 6 hours after run end. We will bill any overage to their account if they exceed. I recommend setting the voucher to: 75,000 tokens, valid from 2028-03-02T06:00:00Z to 2028-03-02T12:00:00Z (UTC).

Operational notes:
- Dev: please reserve a small dedicated pool for the window (limit concurrency to avoid noisy neighbor issues) and add an automatic fallback to the next-compatible model if latency climbs beyond SLA.
- Finance: promo is zero-dollar but requires a credit authorization PDF attached for procurement. I attached a draft below.

Risk: Minimal if we cap by timebox and attach auto-fallback. This is a good moment to show throughput headroom.

If approved, I'll confirm with Elena and push the voucher.

Thanks — Tessa
